title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.INFRA #MCP-STATELESS: MCP 2026-07-28 stateless revision on the site worker, plus agent-readiness as a tracked metric
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=site/agentic.js
code-anchor: async function mcp(request, env)

**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** weekly product-manager pass; the roadmap item is taken by the executor when it is next in driver order
**Program:** QNFO.INFRA
**Metric it should move:** reliability
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call (fleet_budget cap is breached; cost 426.89 vs 300).
**Done check:** grep:site/agentic.js::2026-07-28 ; merged and verified live (VERIFY-LIVE-1) with a probe the author did not write
**Status:** closed

The site /mcp negotiates only 2025-06-18; the seed worker already speaks 2026-07-28 (server/discover, no session ids). Port it, and track the isitagentready.com score as a metric with a breach trigger so interoperability regressions page the loop. Prediction: score up, zero client-version failures.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 168.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
